{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.68","title":"spec 03-adaptation 5.6 vs 5.7: raw-packet profile ceiling contradiction","description":"spec/03-adaptation.md 5.6 says: 'a compressible raw IPv6 packet may be larger when its final encoded SCHC Packet remains at most 22,554 bytes'. 5.7 says the 22554-octet SCHC_FRAGMENT_MAX_PACKET_SIZE ceiling 'bounds the RAW, uncompressed IPv6 packet in BOTH directions... a sender MUST NOT compress a packet whose raw size exceeds the ceiling... Implementations MUST NOT substitute the encoded size for the raw size'. These contradict.

All three implementations enforce the 5.7 (raw-bound) reading:
- Python: headers.py:889-900 raw gate in compress_packet; test_compressed_packet_ceiling_applies_after_encoding (python/tests/schc/test_headers_rules.py:96-120) — raw == MAX compresses, raw+1 rejected.
- Rust: compress() raw rejection before rule dispatch (rust/lichen-schc/src/codec.rs:2253-2260); test mqtt_sn_compress_over_profile_leaves_buffer_untouched (codec.rs:2799).
- C: per-rule raw ceiling gates (lichen/subsys/lichen/schc/schc_compress.c:120,191,258,309,360,417); boundary test lichen/tests/schc_rule2_compress/main.c:147-152.

Fix: rewrite the 5.6 sentence to the raw-bound reading (encoded size never substitutes for the raw bound), matching 5.7.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-09-01T10:43:13.692842107Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-09-01T10:43:13.692842107Z","labels":["spec","spec-gap"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.68","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-09-01T10:43:13.810288311Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
